title: NASDAQ Composite Index closes up 35.5 points for the week, rising for the 3rd straight day
text:
NASDAQ Composite Index closes up 35.5 points for the week, rising for the 3rd straight day August 02, 2018, 04:45:11 PM EDT By NASDAQ.com News Shutterstock photo
Thursday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index 95.4 This is the 3rd straight day of increase for the index. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.1 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 1.57 to 1 ratio. There were 1859 advancers and 1183 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 64 stocks reached a 52 week high and 50 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed up 1.36% for the day; a total of 99.26 points. The current value is 7,372.15. Wynn Resorts, Limited ( WYNN ) had the largest percent change down (-6.53%) while Tesla, Inc. ( TSLA ) had the largest percent change gain rising 16.16%. The Dow Jones index closed down -.03% for the day; a total of -7.66 points. The current value is 25,326.16. DowDuPont Inc. ( DWDP ) had the largest percent change down (-2.24%) while Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change gain rising 2.92%. NASDAQ Market Wrap As of 8/2/2018 4:45:01 PM NASDAQ COMPOSITE INDEX
